is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. arabiensis, An. coluzzii, An. gambiae) in North Cameroon.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (kdr-west/1014F) and Vgsc L995S (kdr-east/1014S) in Table 2 and throughout the text.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 provides the number of mosquitoes genotyped for Kdr mutations per health district per year. Supplementary tables S1, S2, and S3 provide breakdowns of allelic frequencies.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquito larvae were collected from 24 field settings in North Cameroon from 2011 to 2015.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study conducting field collections, bioassays, and molecular genotyping.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study provides data for 24 specific localities within three Health Districts (Garoua, Pitoa, Mayo Oulo) in North Cameroon (Table 1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study reports data collected annually from 2011 to 2015.

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a longitudinal study (2011-2015) presenting original data.

supplement.evidence: The paper provides sufficient data in the main text and tables. Supplementary files are mentioned but not required for the core data.

assessment.summary: This study investigated the spatial and temporal dynamics of deltamethrin resistance and Kdr mutations (L1014F and L1014S) in Anopheles gambiae s.l. populations across 24 sites in North Cameroon from 2011 to 2015. It found a significant increase in resistance and Kdr 1014F allele frequencies over the study period.
